title: Echo State Networks for Time Series Forecasting: Hyperparameter Sweep and Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2602.03912v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper investigates the performance of Echo State Networks (ESNs) for univariate forecasting of monthly and quarterly time series from the M4 Forecasting Competition dataset. We evaluate whether a simple first-order autoregressive ESN can serve as a competitive alternative to widely used forecasting methods. The study uses a two-stage design: a Parameter dataset is used to analyze ESN model configurations over leakage rate, spectral radius, reservoir size, and regularization selection, while a disjoint Forecast dataset is reserved for out-of-sample benchmarking. Forecast accuracy is measured using mean absolute scaled error (MASE), symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE), and the overall weighted average (OWA). translated_title: 回声状态网络用于时间序列预测：超参数扫描与基准测试
translated_abstract: 本文研究了回声状态网络（ESN）在M4预测竞赛数据集中月度和季度时间序列单变量预测方面的性能。我们评估了简单的以一阶自回归方式驱动的ESN能否成为广泛使用的预测方法的有竞争力替代方案。该研究采用两阶段设计：使用一个参数数据集分析ESN模型在泄漏率、谱半径、储备池规模和正则化选择等方面的配置，同时保留一个不相交的预测数据集用于样本外基准测试。预测精度通过平均绝对标度误差（MASE）、对称平均绝对百分比误差（sMAPE）和总体加权平均值（OWA）来衡量。ESN与简单基准方法、统计模型（包括自回归积分移动平均模型ARIMA、指数平滑状态空间模型ETS、Theta方法和TBATS）以及多层模型进行了比较。
tldr: 该研究通过系统的超参数扫描和样本外基准测试表明，经过合理配置的简单回声状态网络（ESN）可以在M4竞赛数据集的月度和季度时间序列预测中与ARIMA、ETS、Theta等主流方法相竞争。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through systematic hyperparameter sweeps and out-of-sample benchmarking that a properly configured simple Echo State Network can be competitive with mainstream methods such as ARIMA, ETS, and Theta for monthly and quarterly time series forecasting on the M4 competition dataset.
